name: jud
description: Write, review, fix, measure and tune .jud documents (a Rubric with its policy, the Cases it is graded on, a Recording), and turn a rubric into a typed Rust module, with the judgment crate's own reader and jud command: three skills, and the /jud:rubric, /jud:cases, /jud:check, /jud:record, /jud:eval, /jud:tune and /jud:rust commands.
